name: Coincide
description: A hexagon and a disc, with only the part common to both inked.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% -2.0%, 95.0% 24.0%, 95.0% 76.0%, 50.0% 102.0%, 5.0% 76.0%, 5.0% 24.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% -2.0%, 95.0% 24.0%, 95.0% 76.0%, 50.0% 102.0%, 5.0% 76.0%, 5.0% 24.0%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 42%, transparent 42%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 42%, transparent 42%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
